promptSuffix: Colour grade: marigold gold, deep purple, the warm flicker of hundreds of candles. Rich, saturated, deeply beautiful — this is death celebrated as colour.

translations.memory vs. forgetting: memory and the river that takes it
translations.grief vs. celebration: the same photograph meaning different things
translations.here vs. gone: the person remembered on the altar and the fact of their absence
translations.the living vs. the dead: the two sides of the marigold path
translations.colour vs. darkness: the brightness of dia de los muertos against what it mourns
translations.held vs. let go: held back from the sea and almost letting go
